name: com.jithox/jithox
description: MCP router for read-only IBAN, invoice, VAT and business checks; discovery is free.
title: Jithox

access.freeTier: Discovery needs no account. Five underlying checks need no token: preflight_payment, verify_iban, check_payment_change, check_peppol_ready, lookup_peppol_participant.
access.paid: Other underlying tools may require OAuth and credits; describe_jithox_tool returns current access and price. Missing providers fail closed; an unavailable result is not a pass.

boundaries: Read-only checks; nothing sends, pays or files.
An IBAN check does not prove account ownership. Results are evidence, not legal or tax approval.
